title: [ACT] Yale Unity Security Screen Door Lock $58.57 (Clearance) in-Store @ Bunnings Warehouse Majura Park & Belconnen
body:
Deal: [ACT] Yale Unity Security Screen Door Lock $58.57 (Clearance) in-Store @ Bunnings Warehouse Majura Park & Belconnen

[ValenHuang] Thought it was "Yale University Door Lock" and got confused for a while lmao.
[silverwalker] Exactly what I thought, mayb we need a new pair of glasses
[TheGunslinger] https://bunnings.youinstock.com.au/search/0389088/
[DoctorCalculon] Will this work with a Crimsafe screen door which has a three point locking system?
[CoreJava] Yes it will. However, you may need to cut and revit the metal as thisnlong is slightly longer
[The Hobo] cut and what the metal?
I've had an issue fitting this to my three point locking system and eventually gave up. Would love to know how to fix it.
But my other issue is the gap between my Yale Entrace door and this handle means that there's not enough of a physical gap between our two doors anyway, so it's just sitting here waiting for me to do something with it. But would be good to know how to solve part of the equation at least.
[barg99] and you need to buy the yale 3 point gear. Apparently you can't retro fit.
[HojuGuy] I got someone to get the last one at Majura Park for me
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] Great price. I bought two from Amazon's previous sale at around $120 each. Only wish it had a finger print sensor or integrated keypad.
[Resarf] I have one and hate it.
On multiple occasions we've been locked in the house. If someone tries to open the lock from the outside while we are unlocking from the inside it goes into melt down mode and beeps and flashes and doesn't work. Need to do a full reset to even open the door.
[Gradesbrah] How often do you simultaneously lock and unlock from two locations?
[Resarf] Postman arrives and tries to open the security door as we are trying to unlock it for them.
It is the act of someone opening the locked door from the outside as someone on the inside is unlocking.
If your front door is open and you see someone you know walking towards the security door, the natural thing is to unlock it. And for them the natural thing is to try and open the door.
[Nom] That all makes perfect sense - except for the part where it keeps happening.
Surely after the first time, you now know NOT to unlock the door when you see someone walking up to it … and so everything is fine ?
[Resarf] @Nom: I'm just trying to point out a flaw that I have never seen on a smart lock before.
If you have a guest over and they are going to open the door for someone else you need to tell them "make sure you wait until the other person isn't touching the door until you unlock it!"
Or picture in a fire someone is trying to open the door to get inside and help you, you rush to unlock the door to escape and forget that no one is allowed to hold the door handle while you're unlocking, and now the door is beeping and locked until you can find a pin to hold down the reset button and calibrate it again.
[Nom] @Resarf: Thanks for sharing - it's certainly not ideal !!
[annearj] @Resarf: do you need to reset though? to turn off the alarm you just press and hold the button for 4 seconds and it will turn off
[eloque] From what I gather, you're trying to say that someone on the outside is trying to turn/pull the handle rather than trying to unlock it with a key or latch? I doubt postmen and guests try to unlock it. They might try to open it.
[spy] Don't waste your money on this. Hate it.
